❌ Usage:
• !tip all <amount> - Send tip to everyone
• !tip @user <amount> - Send tip to specific user
• !tip <number> <amount> - Send tip to random users
Example: !tip all 5, !tip @user 10, !tip 3 5

help_loop:
🔹 Loop Commands 🔹
• !loop <message> - Set loop (30s)
• !loop <seconds> - Set interval
• !loop stop - Stop loop
Example: !loop Hello!
Only Hosts can use.
help_privilege:
🔧 Privilege Commands
• !give @user role - Give role
• !remove @user role - Remove role
Only Hosts can use.
help_teleport_basic:
🔹 Teleport 🔹
!tele x y z - Teleport self
!tele @user x y z - Teleport other
!tele <name> - Saved point
!summ @user - Summon
Only VIP+
help_teleport_host:
🔹 Teleport 🔹
!tele x y z - Teleport self
!tele @user x y z - Other
!tele <name> - Saved point
!summ @user - Summon
!create tele <name> - Create
!delete tele <name> - Delete
!bot - Bot position
Only VIP+
help_welcome:
🔹 Welcome Commands 🔹
• !welcome message - Set welcome
• !welcome whisper - As whisper
• !welcome chat - To public
Example: !welcome Hi {username}!
Only Hosts can use.
help_moderation:
🛡️ Moderation Commands (Admin/Host)
• !kick @user - Kick user
• !ban @user - Ban user (permanent)
• !unban @user - Remove ban
• !mute @user [duration] - Mute user
• !unmute @user - Remove mute
Mute duration: 1m, 1h, 1d
